title: Fire & Rescue Service product catalogue, version 1
sourceDescription: Selected product evidence from current vendor pages, checked on 21 November 2026. Claims state what the vendor describes, not proven suitability for an organisation. Editorial review is pending. Coverage spans the sector’s main capability areas but is not exhaustive; a missing product is not evidence that no product exists.

entries.summary: Community fire risk management and fire safety software.

claims.statement: The vendor describes Civica CFRMIS as community fire risk management and fire safety software.

entries.summary: Fire safety audit and protection case management software.

capabilities.name: Premises Risk Inspection
capabilities.howItSupports: Records fire safety inspections and audit work

claims.statement: The vendor describes Active Fire Protection as fire safety audit and protection case management software.

entries.summary: Computer aided dispatch software for emergency control rooms.

capabilities.name: Emergency Call Handling & Mobilisation
capabilities.howItSupports: Supports emergency call handling and mobilisation

claims.statement: The vendor describes Motorola Solutions Computer Aided Dispatch as computer aided dispatch software for emergency control rooms.

entries.summary: Emergency dispatch software for fire services.

capabilities.name: Emergency Call Handling & Mobilisation
capabilities.howItSupports: Helps dispatch crews and track fire incidents

claims.statement: The vendor describes Octave OnCall Fire Dispatch as emergency dispatch software for fire services.

entries.summary: Mapping and analysis tools for fire service community risk.

capabilities.name: Community Risk Profiling
capabilities.howItSupports: Analyses risk patterns and locations for prevention planning

capabilities.name: Community Risk Management Planning
capabilities.howItSupports: Supports community risk planning with mapped evidence

claims.statement: The vendor describes ArcGIS Community Risk Reduction as mapping and analysis tools for fire service community risk.

entries.summary: Training management software for fire services.
